name: Shindou Hatsune
source:
A serious girl with a strong sense of justice who hates crooked things.
She is the president of the student council at school and can be a bit stubborn, but her looks and behavior make her popular with both men
and women. She is often confessed to due to her natural talents such as her face and style, but she has never dated a boy because the school rules prohibit impure heterosexual relations. She
also works harder than anyone else, so her grades are always at the top. As a Prism Breaker, she fights every day against

the evil organization <Grenada> that attacks the city . No matter how hard it is for her, she believes in protecting the weak and those in trouble. Her overwhelming fighting power also makes her unpopular with the executives of <Grenada>.
